REQUIRED declaration: subject_lesson_id + subject_promotion_receipt_sha256 + parent_lesson_id + parent_promotion_receipt_sha256 + parent_selected_commit (40-64 hex) + parent_installed_policy_sha256, all signature-covered. Every installed generation carries exactly one lineage record.

bindings.value: Every standing projection in run_rsi_004.py goes through project_lineage_memories(), which calls derive_airlock_memory_with_lineage exactly once per projection with: all generations' generation/promotion/standing records, the complete receiver-minted lineage record set, installed policy bytes per parent, and the airlock key. The harness mints the lineage set once before REOPEN and reuses the identical bytes after REOPEN; it never edits, reorders, or re-mints lineage records between projections.
bindings.verification: Self-check parses run_rsi_004.py and asserts the only calls to derive_airlock_memory_with_lineage occur inside project_lineage_memories, and that the lineage record set is loaded once from disk. invariant_under_test: standing follows required lineage: a generation's standing can be no cleaner than the standing of the generation its REQUIRED lineage binds it to; questioning propagates transitively to a deterministic fixed point; unrelated accepted branches are preserved; installation is history, standing is judgment.
negative_controls: Forged REOPEN signed with the wrong key is rejected; gen1 standing unchanged.
The repair's adversarial suite (15 lineage tests) runs green in self-check: missing/forged/conflicting/dangling/incomplete/cyclic lineage all fail closed with no clean inheritance.
gen4 admission probe: the probe is computed, never executed; ADMIT is a failure of the gate, not a step toward building gen4.
projector_finding: derive_airlock_memory_with_lineage at the pinned repair commit derives local standing first with the exact pre-repair rules, then propagates questioned standing transitively through receiver-signed REQUIRED lineage dependencies to a deterministic fixed point (Claim Graph impact pattern, reimplemented natively). Missing, forged, conflicting, dangling, incomplete, or cyclic lineage fails closed. The generation-local derive_airlock_memory() is unchanged: 12-case differential vs 454c5a3b, 0 mismatches.
question: With a lineage-aware projector, when gen1's receiver evidence is reopened, does questioned standing propagate transitively through receiver-signed REQUIRED lineage to gen2 and gen3 — while an unrelated accepted root survives, historical receipts stay byte-identical, installed refs stay byte-identical, and a gen4 admission probe through gen3 is denied?
sequence: select-gen1 (fresh process): Nightshift selects exactly one winner; lineage ROOT(gen1) minted by the receiver key, bound to gen1's promotion receipt.
install-gen1 (fresh process): install exact selected commit at refs/heads/rsi-004/installed-gen1; promotion receipt signed and bound; standing 'inherited'; R1-gen1 byte hash recorded.

select-gen2 (fresh process): R1-gen1 at gen1's selected commit; pristine archive extracted; policy binding verified; gen2 work branch from R1-gen1; Nightshift with gen2 shim; lineage REQUIRED(gen2 -> gen1) minted, binding all five lineage fields.
install-gen2 (fresh process): install exact selected commit at refs/heads/rsi-004/installed-gen2; standing 'inherited'; R1-gen2 byte hash recorded.
select-gen3 + install-gen3 (fresh processes): same pattern on the gen2 line; lineage REQUIRED(gen3 -> gen2) minted.
select-rootU + install-rootU (fresh processes): independent base; lineage ROOT(rootU) minted; standing RETAIN recorded (accepted branch).
checkpoint projection (fresh process): lineage-aware projection over all four generations; expected all 'inherited'; all receipt byte hashes recorded.
valid REOPEN(gen1) (fresh process): minted by the airlock key, bound to gen1's promotion receipt; forged-REOPEN negative control rejected.
RESTART BOUNDARY: reprojection (fresh process) reloads all receipts, lineage records, and installed policy bytes from disk; lineage record set sha256 must equal the checkpoint value.
reprojection: expected gen1 questioned (local rule), gen2 and gen3 questioned (witness airlock-lineage-questioned, ancestor paths gen2 -> gen1 and gen3 -> gen2 -> gen1 recorded), rootU inherited.
gen4 admission probe (no execution): evaluate the projection for a hypothetical gen4 with REQUIRED lineage to gen3; expected questioned / DENY.
verdict: apply verdict_precedence; write receipt with all hashes, process IDs, and projection outputs.
title: Lineage-aware inheritance: transitive questioned-standing propagation through receiver-signed required lineage
verdict_precedence: Pre-REOPEN precondition failure (any generation not inherited at checkpoint -> cause_code CHECKPOINT_NOT_ESTABLISHED; any lineage binding unverifiable -> cause_code LINEAGE_BINDING_FAILURE) -> INCONCLUSIVE_RSI_004_PRECONDITION_FAILURE.
Any installed-ref byte mutation -> FAIL_RSI_004_REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED with cause_code INSTALLED_REF_MUTATION.
Any historical receipt byte mutation -> FAIL_RSI_004_REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED with cause_code RECEIPT_MUTATION.
Post-reprojection outputs differ across two independent reprojections -> FAIL_RSI_004_REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED with cause_code PROJECTION_NONDETERMINISM.
gen1 not questioned after valid REOPEN -> INCONCLUSIVE_RSI_004_PRECONDITION_FAILURE with cause_code REOPEN_NOT_OBSERVED.

gen1 questioned, gen2 questioned, gen3 questioned, rootU inherited, gen4 probe DENIED, all receipts and refs byte-identical, reprojection deterministic -> PASS_RSI_004_LINEAGE_AWARE_INHERITANCE with cause_code NONE.
gen1 questioned but any of gen2/gen3 inherited, or rootU questioned, or gen4 probe ADMITTED -> FAIL_RSI_004_REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED with cause_code REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED.
Any other post-projection combination -> INCONCLUSIVE_RSI_004_PRECONDITION_FAILURE with the nearest cause_code.

verdicts.PASS_RSI_004_LINEAGE_AWARE_INHERITANCE: gen1 questioned after valid REOPEN (local rule); gen2 and gen3 questioned after reprojection with deterministic ancestor/witness paths recorded; unrelated accepted root rootU remains inherited; gen4 admission probe through gen3 denied (computed, not executed); all historical receipts byte-identical; all installed refs byte-identical; reprojection deterministic.
verdicts.FAIL_RSI_004_REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFOR: The lineage-aware projector ran, but required ancestry was not enforced. The exact diagnostic is carried in cause_code; the formal verdict is always this FAIL.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE_RSI_004_PRECONDITION_FAILUR: The propagation question could not be put to the mechanism. The exact diagnostic is carried in cause_code; the formal verdict is always this INCONCLUSIVE.

cause_codes.REQUIRED_ANCESTRY_NOT_ENFORCED: A descendant of questioned gen1 kept inherited standing, or the unrelated accepted root was incorrectly questioned, or the gen4 admission probe was admitted through questioned gen3.
cause_codes.INSTALLED_REF_MUTATION: Any installed-ref byte mutation at any point. REOPEN changes standing, not history.
cause_codes.RECEIPT_MUTATION: Any generation, promotion, standing, or lineage receipt byte change between checkpoint and reprojection. REOPEN changes standing judgment, not history.
cause_codes.PROJECTION_NONDETERMINISM: Two independent reprojections from disk produced different projection outputs.
cause_codes.LINEAGE_BINDING_FAILURE: A lineage binding failed to verify at projection time (missing, forged, conflicting, dangling, incomplete, or cyclic lineage). Fail-closed is the correct projector behavior; the experiment cannot test propagation without valid lineage.
cause_codes.REOPEN_NOT_OBSERVED: gen1 was not questioned after the valid REOPEN was issued.
cause_codes.CHECKPOINT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: A generation failed to establish at the pre-REOPEN checkpoint.
